'''2015 MPC Matt Carulli LS This Is Getting Out Of Hand''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Carulli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Is Getting Out Of Hand Carulli.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-match-play-championship.html swccg.com snapshot], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163223/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
